runId.description: Unique identifier for this run, used in temp file naming and output file naming.

projectRoot.description: Absolute path to the project root where the vitest config and node_modules live.

targets.description: Source units to generate unit tests for.

name.description: Short name for this unit (used in test describe blocks and output filenames).

sourceFile.description: Path to the source file relative to projectRoot (e.g. 'src/services/metrics/sales-by-week/api.ts').

exportedSymbols.description: Optional list of specific exported functions/constants to test. If omitted, Unit-Test-QA determines what to test from reading the file.

context.description: Optional context from API-Agent or Bob about what this unit does and what edge cases matter. Helps Unit-Test-QA focus on the highest-risk logic.

apiContractHints.description: Optional fieldMappings from API-Agent for transformation correctness tests.

testFramework.description: Test framework to use. Defaults to vitest. Determines import style and runner command.

frontendSubdir.description: If the vitest config is in a subdirectory (e.g. 'frontend'), specify it here. Temp dir is created relative to this path within projectRoot.
